title: 2006 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Luc Alphand / Gilles Picard (Mitsubishi) and Marc Coma (KTM)
summary: The 2006 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 16 stage towns and bivouacs through Portugal, Spain, Morocco, Mauritania, Mali, Guinea, Senegal. Winners — Cars: Luc Alphand / Gilles Picard (Mitsubishi); Bikes: Marc Coma (KTM); Trucks: Vladimir Chagin / Semen Yakubov / Sergey Savostin (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
